data.other_hard: financial need; child of a U.S. military service member who died on active duty on or after September 11, 2001, or who was injured on active duty on or after September 11, 2001 with a combined VA disability rating of 50% or higher; attending or accepted to an accredited U.S. institution of higher education
data.evidence_sentence: Must be a high school senior or graduate who has been accepted to or is currently attending an accredited institution of higher education within the United States.
data.notes: Page covers two award categories with different amounts: children of fallen post-9/11 servicemembers (up to $20,000) and children of post-9/11 veterans with a VA disability rating of 50% or higher (up to $5,000). The page does not state a citizenship requirement or subject areas. Renewal is possible up to six times if eligibility and financial need continue, but this is not an entry requirement. Deadline is for the 2027-28 academic year; awards must be used before August 1, 2028.
